content.title: Selfie-Carrier Group Memory Montage | Activity Proof, Group Growth, Communal Close
content.summary: Keep one clearly adult selfie carrier recognizable across rapid native-phone jump cuts inside one gathering. Alternate activity inserts with repeated carrier returns, grow the group in countable stages, preserve imperfect handheld behavior, and end on the largest group completing one shared action.

quick_start.input_format: one clearly adult selfie carrier + one coherent gathering with recurring anchors + activity inserts alternating with carrier returns + group growth in at least three stages + imperfect native-phone cuts + largest group completes one communal action
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult marine biologist records a dockside sensor-launch phone diary. A yellow equipment crate and blue mooring post recur while samples are opened, sensors checked, and adult teammates arrive in stages; the buoy activates once, the crew cheers, and the largest group ends with one gloved fist-circle around the same selfie carrier.
required_anchors: Keep one clearly adult original selfie carrier recognizable across every phase.
Stay within one coherent gathering and repeat at least two environmental anchors.
Increase the readable group state through at least three stages while retaining natural imperfect phone behavior.
End on the largest group state and one complete shared action.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Keep one clearly adult selfie carrier recognizable across rapid native-phone jump cuts inside one gathering. Alternate activity inserts with repeated carrier returns, grow the group in countable stages, preserve imperfect handheld behavior, and end on the largest group completing one shared action.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Use one clearly adult original selfie carrier as the identity anchor across a rapid native-phone montage in one coherent gathering. Alternate short activity inserts with repeated returns to the carrier, and let the visible group grow in countable stages: setup, task, arrivals, peak collective reaction and complete shared gesture. Preserve recurring environmental anchors, ordinary jump cuts, slight shake, focus breathing and late recentering without losing the carrier. End on the largest readable group state and one completed communal action. The reusable mechanism is selfie anchor, activity proof, progressive group growth, imperfect phone grammar and terminal communal gesture—not the source woman, face, sports clothing, stadium, parking lot, car trunks, grills, burgers, drinks, team gear, friends, exact prompt, timing, creator identity or model label.

invariants.rule: Keep one clearly adult original selfie carrier recognizable across every phase.
invariants.purpose: Provides identity continuity through rapid cuts.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing the carrier turns the sequence into an unrelated compilation.

invariants.rule: Stay within one coherent gathering and repeat at least two environmental anchors.
invariants.purpose: Makes jump cuts read as one event.

invariants.rule: Alternate activity proof with returns to the carrier rather than showing only faces.
invariants.purpose: Answers what the group is doing and why it grows.
invariants.ablation_failure: A face-only montage lacks causal event progression.

invariants.rule: Increase the readable group state through at least three stages while retaining natural imperfect phone behavior.
invariants.purpose: Builds social escalation without staged coverage.
invariants.ablation_failure: A constant group or polished stabilization flattens the candid arc.

invariants.rule: End on the largest group state and one complete shared action.
invariants.purpose: Provides a countable terminal memory payoff.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending mid-pan or before the gesture leaves the event unresolved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source woman's likeness, hair, clothing, smile, gestures and exact selfie angles
the source stadium parking lot, car trunks, coolers, grills, burgers, drinks and sports gear
the source friends, team identities, group arrangement, cheers, high-fives and toast timing
the source rapid-cut order, camera shake pattern, focus changes, exposure and color treatment
the source creator identity, exact prompt wording, Seedance 2.0 claim, platform overlay, watermark and branding
